C1800.title: Hengshan Public Security Cracks AI-Forged Evidence Fraud Case, Repeat Offender Sentenced to One Year for Malicious Claims
keywords: Hengshan Public Security cracks AI-forged evidence fraud case
C1800.summary: In June 2026, the Hengshan County Public Security Bureau cracked the first case of malicious e-commerce fraud using AI technology during the 'Operation Clean Net 2026' campaign. The suspect, surnamed Tan, exploited platform rule loopholes by using AI-forged evidence and multi-account cash-out methods to make malicious claims, forming a fraud loop, and was ultimately held criminally liable and sentenced to one year in prison.
